rootCause: The importer intentionally renders #imp-file with display:none behind a visible label. The QA harness required the hidden input to be visible even though setInputFiles supports attached hidden file inputs.

fix.selectorContract: wait for #imp-file state=attached, then use setInputFiles
fix.additionalTelemetry: Print B4_003_RENEWAL_RENDER_STABILITY immediately after the renewal stability window.
